```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"America's healthcare professionals should not be forced to choose between following their faith and practicing their profession.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The rights of conscience of healthcare professionals, doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and organizations should be respected.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Organizations should be able to provide, purchase, or enroll in healthcare coverage consistent with their religious, moral, or ethical convictions without discrimination or penalty.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Parents have the right to determine the proper medical treatment and therapy for their minor children.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Legislation requiring parental consent for their daughter to be transported across state lines for abortion should be enacted.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Providers should not be permitted to unilaterally withhold services because a patient's life is deemed not worth living.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"American taxpayers should not be forced to fund abortion.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Hyde Amendment should be codified and applied across the government, including Obamacare.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A permanent ban on federal funding and subsidies for abortion and healthcare plans that include abortion coverage should be established.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are abandoning a four decade-old bipartisan consensus.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
